description:
## Problem
The V, A, VQ, AQ and EQ sets are BenchBox's invention: 7 of 10 AQ return inflated numbers, 4 of 12 VQ always fail, 5 of 8 EQ are constants or tautologies, and none is in the specification.

## Owner decisions (choice dialogs, 2026-11-20)
- "Remove them from TPC-DI, with their dialect variants, golden-corpus entries and tests." (decision 6)

## Change
Plan S5. Delete queries.py, query_analytics.py, query_etl.py, query_validation.py; get_query/get_queries, the variant and override code and the VQ coupling in benchmark.py; sql_compat/rules/query_source/tpcdi_variants.py and rules/execution_filter/lakesail_tpcdi.py; the TPC-DI entries in query_catalog.py, benchmark_specs.yaml and tpc_validation.py; the TPC-DI keys of the translation golden corpus, splitting ClickBench into its own area with its keys byte-identical; the query tests; the soundness-paths, pyproject and api-public-symbols entries. Breaking changelog fragment.

## Decision gates
The breaking changelog text and the list of removed public symbols are shown in the pull request description. If a TPC-DI idiom rewrite is used by another benchmark, keep it and say so. If the ClickBench golden keys cannot be kept byte-identical, stop.

## Verification rubric
Pass: `rg -n '\\b(VQ|AQ|EQ)\\d+\\b|TPCDIQueryManager|tpcdi_variants|LAKESAIL_TPCDI' benchbox tests scripts` prints nothing; the ClickBench golden entries are byte-identical before and after (hash in the pull request); `uv run -- pytest tests/unit/sql_compat/golden_corpus -q`, `make compat-inventory-check`, `make comment-policy-check` and `make pr-preflight` pass.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20)
- The agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`.
- Arming: `make pr-arm` once; one more attempt only when the refusal named a cause, the agent reported it and the cause is cleared; never a third without asking. `make pr-rerun` at most once and only for a job the runner never ran or cancelled, never for a failed test.
- Review threads: reply; resolve only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise the finding again.
- Subagents are read-only. No file edit by script; use the edit tool. Do not edit a pull request description while its CI is starting; post a comment.
- Any limit, default, threshold, status token, message or label text the owner has not already chosen (see tpcdi-correction-plan-20261120) is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- A blocked step stops this item; no workaround. No live cloud run. Heavy work only through `make heavy-run`. One pull request for this item, merged before the next item starts.
- From the quarantine step until the reopening step, no TPC-DI entry point may produce a result that reads PASSED or is admitted for publication.
